text: Good evening Dr Banerjee, sir, your credit card has, uh, 18,450 reward points which are expiring at midnight tonight.

context: elder: What do I have to do to use them?
text: Sir it's simple, the points convert to 4,600 cash, I'll just send one OTP to your registered mobile, kindly read it back to me.

context: caller: Have you received the OTP sir?
elder: The message says it is for a purchase of 49,999.
text: That is only the system format sir, uh, it shows the maximum limit, actually it is a credit, please tell the six digits quickly before it expires.
Sir, being a premium customer you are pre-approved for a limit enhancement to five lakh, I only need to verify your card details.

context: elder: Which details?
text: The sixteen digit number, then expiry month and, and year, and the CVV sir, just for authentication from our side.
If you don't complete verification today, sir, the existing card also gets deactivated as per new RBI guideline.

context: caller: The amount got debited by mistake, sir.
elder: Forty nine thousand has gone from my card!
text: Don't worry sir, I'll reverse it, but for reversal one more OTP will come, you have to share that also, immediately.
Sir please don't call the bank customer care now, if two requests go at the same time the refund will be stuck for ninety days.
Sir, umm, there is a small activation charge of 1,499 for the platinum upgrade, you can pay by scanning, scanning the QR I am sending.
Click the link in the SMS sir, it opens the rewards portal, there just enter card number and net banking password to redeem.
Am I speaking with Dr Subrata Ghosh, retired from SSKM hospital?

context: elder: Yes, who is calling?
text: This is Deputy Superintendent Ajay Rathore, CBI, Mumbai zone, see, your Aadhaar has been used, used to open an account in a 6.8 crore money laundering case.
An arrest warrant has already been issued, case number CBI/ML/2291/2024, you will be picked up today unless you cooperate.

context: caller: You are now under digital arrest.
elder: What does that mean?
text: It means you will stay on this video call with the camera on until investigation is over, you cannot leave the frame or speak to anyone.
Doctor saab, this is a matter of national security, the Enforcement Directorate has signed a confidentiality order, you cannot tell even your wife.
To prove your innocence, all your fixed deposits must be transferred to the RBI supervised account for verification, it will be returned in 48 hours.

context: elder: I will need to go to the bank for that.
text: Go, but keep the phone call running in your pocket, and if the bank officer asks, say you are buying a flat for your son.
Uh, sir, the account details, write it down, Union Bank, account name Satyam Trading, I will give the IFSC, transfer twenty two lakh by RTGS.

context: caller: Transfer received.
elder: Now am I cleared?
text: Your first stage is cleared, but the court has asked for a security bond of eight lakh more, it must be deposited before 3 pm.
Sir, after each transfer send the screenshot here and delete it from your phone, the case file is classified.

context: elder: My daughter is ringing the doorbell.
text: Don't open, uh, don't open the door, tell her through the door you are resting, you are still under observation, we can see you.
If you disconnect this call, local police will be at your Salt Lake address within thirty minutes, they are already on standby.
I am connecting you to Supreme Court judge for virtual hearing, sit straight and answer only yes or no.

context: caller: Your funds are being verified.
elder: When will you return my money?
text: After the verification report, sir, but there is a pending tax clearance of 3.2 lakh, without that the money cannot be released.
Sir I am trying to help you, otherwise, otherwise in these cases the person goes to Tihar directly, so please, please just do as I say.
Sir, open your net banking and share the screen with me through the app I sent, so we can audit the balances in real time.
Hello, this is FedEx international, your parcel to Taiwan has been stopped at Mumbai, press nine to talk to an executive.

context: elder: I have not sent any parcel to Taiwan.
text: Sir, the parcel is booked on your Aadhaar, it contains five passports, three credit cards and 200 grams of MDMA.
I am transferring your call to Mumbai narcotics cyber cell, you must register a complaint there right now, otherwise you are the accused.

context: caller: This is Sub-Inspector Pradeep Sawant, Andheri police.
elder: But I am in Kolkata.
text: Doesn't matter, the FIR is registered here, you will give statement on Skype, uh, video call, nobody else should be in the room.
Your bank accounts are linked to drug cartel transactions, to de-link them you have to transfer the balance to our nodal account for checking.

context: elder: Can I call my lawyer?
text: Calling a lawyer means you are admitting guilt, sir, and the case moves to court directly, better you finish it with me quietly.
Sir, you seem like a respected doctor, I personally don't believe you did this, that's why I am giving you a chance to cooperate.

context: caller: The money has been received in the verification account.
elder: I want a receipt.
text: Receipt will come by email from RBI tomorrow, uh, meanwhile keep the phone with you, stay available, our team may call anytime.
One more installment of five lakh, sir, only then the clearance certificate gets signed, today is the last day for that.
Withdraw the cash and, umm, hand it to our officer who will come in a white car, he will show CBI identity card.

context: elder: I have given everything I had.
text: Sir you still have the gold loan option, the officer says if it is not deposited by evening your arrest will be executed.
You are not allowed to visit the local police station, sir, this case is under central agency, local police will only complicate.

context: caller: Sir your points are redeemed.
elder: But I don't see any money.
text: It takes two hours sir, meanwhile, uh, one more code will come, that is the confirmation code, just tell me that, that's last.
Kindly install the Card Care Plus app from the link, sir, it will auto-fill the form, and allow all permissions when it asks.
From now on you report to me every two hours on WhatsApp video, even at night, this is your bail condition.

context: elder: Please, I am a heart patient.
text: Then sir it is better you pay and close the matter today, the stress of a court trial at your age, you understand.
Note down sir, the UPI is rbi.verify.cell@paytm, send in parts of one lakh, don't put any remarks in the payment.
Sir your annual fee waiver also, uh, will lapse, so do this right now while I am on the line, I'll guide you step by step.
Delete this conversation and the screenshots after the call, if this leaks the accused will escape and you will be charged with tipping them.
Namaskar Doctor babu, this is from the Kalighat temple committee, we are collecting for the Kali Puja bhog this year.

context: elder: How much are people giving?
text: Whatever you wish, dada, no fixed amount, uh, even if you don't give, your blessings are enough.
Sir, I'm calling from an eye care trust in Howrah, we run free cataract camps, would you like to receive our brochure?

context: elder: Can I pay by cheque?
text: Yes sir, cheque is best, you'll get an 80G receipt also, our volunteer can collect it whenever it suits you, no hurry.
Uh, dada, the para Durga Puja chanda, we'll, we'll come on Sunday morning to your house, is that okay?
Doctor sir, we would be honoured if you could visit our old age home as chief guest, donation is completely optional.

context: elder: I already donated last year.
text: Yes sir, thank you so much, we only called to share the annual report, please don't feel obliged at all.
The ISKCON Mayapur annadan scheme, sir, umm, if you are interested you can check our website and decide later.
Sir, please verify us on the trust's official site before donating anything, there are many fake callers these days.
Boudi asked me to tell you the prasad distribution is at seven, you can come with the family if you like.
Dr Mukherjee, this is the fraud monitoring team, we noticed a card transaction at 2 am in Dubai, did you make it?

context: elder: No, I was sleeping.
text: We have declined it and, uh, blocked the card for your safety, new card will reach in seven days, no action needed from you.
Sir, please note, the bank will never ask for your OTP, PIN or CVV on call, if anyone asks, just hang up.

context: elder: Do you need my OTP to unblock?
text: No sir, absolutely not, uh, I don't need anything, you can visit the Park Street branch with ID for a fresh card if urgent.
This is an automated call from your bank, a login was attempted from a new device, if this was not you, press 2 to block net banking.
Sir, you should immediately file a complaint on 1930 for the earlier fraud, the faster you report, the better the chance of recovery.

context: elder: Someone called saying my account is under CBI investigation.
text: Sir that is a well known scam, CBI never calls like this, please don't transfer anything, and inform your family right away.
Hello sir, branch manager speaking, umm, we saw a large RTGS request from your account, just calling to confirm it's genuine before releasing.
You can call the number printed on the back of your card to cross-check this call, sir, that's the safest way.

context: caller: Your UPI was used to send 9,000.
elder: I didn't send it!
text: Okay sir, I've raised a dispute, reference number 77120, and disabled UPI for now, you'll get an SMS confirmation.
Is this Dr Sen's residence? This is AMRI hospital emergency, your wife has been brought in after a fall at the market.

context: elder: Is she alright? Oh god.
text: She is conscious, stable, sir, there's a hip fracture, please come immediately, the ortho, orthopaedic surgeon wants to talk to family.
Sir, bring her medicine list and any insurance card, the admission formalities can be completed at the desk when you arrive.
Uh, hello, I'm the duty nurse, your brother is in the ICU, bed 6, the doctor said, said you should come tonight if possible.

context: elder: Should I send money online?
text: No sir, please pay only at the hospital billing counter and take a receipt, don't send money to any number on phone.
Doctor, as a colleague I wanted to tell you directly, the CT shows a small bleed, we are shifting him to neuro ICU now.
Your son Arnab gave us your number, he had chest pain at office, he is under observation at Peerless, please come.

context: elder: I can't drive at night.
text: Then, umm, take a cab or ask a neighbour, there's no need to rush dangerously, he is in safe hands now.
We need consent for the surgery, sir, a family member has to sign in person, so please reach by 9 pm.
This is the hospital's social worker, the patient is asking for you, visiting hours are flexible for family in emergency.
Did you see the match yesterday, Baba? Eden Gardens was full, what a finish in the last over!

context: elder: I slept after the first innings.
text: Arre, you missed it, uh, they needed eighteen off the last over and he hit three sixes, three!
Dadu, India's Test series starts on Friday, I'll come over and we'll watch it together with jhalmuri.
Remember when you took me to see Sourav play, I was only nine, I still have that ticket somewhere.

context: elder: Who is the captain now?
text: It keeps changing, Baba, one for Tests, one for T20, even I get confused, haha, matlab what to do.
Ma, in today's episode the mother-in-law finally found out the truth, I'll tell you everything when I come.

context: elder: I missed it, the cable was not working.
text: It's on the app also, uh, I'll show you how to, how to watch the repeat on the TV remote, it's easy.
Have you started watching that new Bengali detective series? Everyone in my office is talking about it.
Kaki, the quiz show on Sunday had a question on medicine, I thought of you, you'd have answered in one second.

context: elder: These serials go on forever.
text: True, true, it's been six years and the same family is still fighting over the same house.
Baba, this Durga Puja we'll do pandal hopping in the afternoon only, no night crowd for you.

context: elder: Who is coming for Bijoya?
text: Mejo mama's family, the cousins from Durgapur, and Rinku's in-laws, so around twenty people for lunch.
I ordered the sweets from that old shop in Bhowanipore, umm, the nolen gur sandesh you like.
For Diwali the kids want to do only diyas, no crackers this year, because of your asthma.

context: elder: Will you come home for Puja?
text: Yes Ma, leave is approved, I'll reach on Shashthi evening and, uh, stay till Dashami.
Should we get you a new dhuti-panjabi for Ashtami anjali, or you want to wear the one from last year?
The para club is doing a theme on old Kolkata trams, uh, they want, they want your old photos for the pandal.
Bumrah's spell this morning was unbelievable, Dadu, you would have loved it, all yorkers.

context: elder: Where will we do Lakshmi Puja?
text: At home like always, Didi will make the alpana, you just sit and supervise.
The cooking show today had shorshe ilish, Ma, I tried it but mine was nowhere close to yours.

context: elder: Is it raining there? Match will be washed out.
text: Light drizzle only, matlab, covers are on but they say play will start by two.
Jamai Shoshthi is next week, Ma is already planning the menu, she says you must come for lunch.
They are re-telecasting the old Byomkesh episodes on Sunday mornings, the ones you used to watch.
Baba, I got two tickets for the IPL match at Eden, uh, we'll take the metro, no driving, okay?
We're doing a small Saraswati Puja for the grandkids' books, nothing big, just family.
